---
title: "Segmentation — test run"
format: html
---

R orchestrates; the segmenter lives in the engine. This just runs it and looks
at the output.

## Setup ----
```{r setup, include=FALSE, purl=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(root.dir = here::here())
.name_script <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) {
  knitr::current_input()
} else {
  rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()[["path"]]
}
.name_script <- fs::path_ext_remove(basename(.name_script))
library <- function(...) suppressPackageStartupMessages(base::library(...))
```

```{r}
.dir_main <- file.path("2_output", .name_script)
fs::dir_create(.dir_main)

.python_bin <- here::here("contracts-engine", ".venv", "bin", "python")
.segment_py <- here::here("contracts-engine", "segment.py")
.docs_sample <- here::here("0_sample", "*.parquet")
.dir_out <- .dir_main

.seg_path <- fs::path(.dir_main, "segments.parquet")
.anc_path <- fs::path(.dir_main, "anchors.parquet")
```

```{r}
system2(.python_bin, c(
  shQuote(.segment_py),
  shQuote(.docs_sample),
  "--mode", "blank_line",
  "--out-segments", shQuote(.seg_path),
  "--out-anchors", shQuote(.anc_path)
))
```



## Look at the output ----

```{r inspect}
segments <- arrow::read_parquet(.seg_path)
anchors <- arrow::read_parquet(.anc_path)

dplyr::glimpse(segments)

# per-doc segment counts
segments |>
  dplyr::count(DocID, name = "NSegments")

# boilerplate dedup: identical clauses collapse on SegHash
segments |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    NSegments = dplyr::n(),
    NUnique = dplyr::n_distinct(SegHash)
  )
```


```{r}


```


```{r}
# call the engine's pinned venv directly -- no cwd / uv juggling
python_bin <- here::here("contracts-engine", ".venv", "bin", "python")
segment_py <- here::here("contracts-engine", "segment.py")

docs_glob <- here::here("0_sample", "*.parquet")   # drop a few real docs here
out_dir <- here::here("2_output", "segments")      # R owns 2_output
fs::dir_create(out_dir)

seg_path <- fs::path(out_dir, "segments.parquet")
anc_path <- fs::path(out_dir, "anchors.parquet")
```

## Run the segmenter ----

```{r run}
system2(python_bin, c(
  shQuote(segment_py),
  shQuote(docs_glob),
  "--mode", "blank_line",
  "--out-segments", shQuote(seg_path),
  "--out-anchors", shQuote(anc_path)
))
```

## Look at the output ----

```{r inspect}
segments <- arrow::read_parquet(seg_path)
anchors <- arrow::read_parquet(anc_path)

dplyr::glimpse(segments)

# per-doc segment counts
segments |>
  dplyr::count(DocID, name = "NSegments")

# boilerplate dedup: identical clauses collapse on SegHash
segments |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    NSegments = dplyr::n(),
    NUnique = dplyr::n_distinct(SegHash)
  )
```

## Spot-check: do the engine's offsets slice correctly in R? ----

```{r spotcheck}
# R is 1-based, so Start + 1; Stop is the inclusive end. Should be readable text.
one <- arrow::read_parquet(
  Sys.glob(docs_glob)[1],
  col_select = dplyr::all_of(c("DocID", "TextRaw"))
)
seg0 <- segments |>
  dplyr::filter(DocID == one$DocID[1], SegmentID == 0)

stringi::stri_sub(one$TextRaw[1], seg0$Start + 1, seg0$Stop)
```
